text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The curry goes bubble bubble, the<n>steak goes sizzle
sizzle.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Gah! Bubble... sizzle... N-no, I can't!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's it, Oguri, hold back da urge!<n>This is all for
Creek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Rice so soft... and fluffy, fluffy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Gahhh! I-I can't take it anymore...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, Oguri! You promised! Remember<n>Creek's
birthday present?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We're supposed to be "brats in our<n>terrible twos
who refuse to be<n>pampered"! I know it's a
mouthful,<n>but still!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Tamtam, do you have any<n>laundry? Make
sure to put out your<n>jersey and bento box later,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, gimme a break, I can do it myself,<n>Mo—crap, that
was close! Too easy to<n>fall into that trap!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, fluffy fluffy... fluffy fluffy, fluffy!<n>Must... resist!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's it, you two, you can do it. ♪ Let<n>all the
whining and sulking out. That<n>way...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Later, you can be my pampered little<n>girls. That'll be
the real present,<n>won't it? Teehee. ♪
